about.label: About
about.title: From rock to value, from student to engineer
about.intro: CHMK is the official student club run by the students of the Mineral Processing Engineering Department at Istanbul Technical University.
about.whatText: Mineral processing is the transformation of mined ore into industrial concentrates: liberation by crushing, grinding and screening, followed by enrichment through flotation, gravity and magnetic separation. The copper in your phone, the aluminium in your car and the lithium in your battery all pass through these processes. Mineral processing engineers design this transformation to be efficient, economical and environmentally responsible.
about.missionText: To connect students with the field, the industry and current technologies, raising the visibility of the department and the quality of its graduates.
about.visionText: To be the most active and best-connected student community in mineral processing in Türkiye.
about.historyText: Our club was founded in 2008 under the ITU Faculty of Mines. Since then it has run a growing program of technical trips, seminars and trainings every year.
